outputs.explanation: Panel A reports exact p-values (p<0.001, p=0.002, p=0.047) directly on the plot rather than using significance symbols (e.g., asterisks), so there are no symbols requiring definition.
Panel B is a photographic gross image, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel C is a set of histology/staining micrographs, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel D shows dot blot and staining images, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel E reports an exact p-value (p=0.002) directly on the plot rather than using a significance symbol, so there is no symbol requiring definition.

The bottom bar graph in panel F reports exact p-values (p<0.001, p=0.031) directly on the plot rather than using significance symbols, so there are no symbols requiring definition. The top portion of panel F is a western blot image, not a plot.
